lines: So, uh, what's the one story in college basketball you can't stop thinking about right now?
Oh, it's not a blue blood. Um, it's a town of about fifty thousand people in central Illinois.
Normal, Illinois. Illinois State. The Redbirds.
And this is a program that, I mean, for a long time nobody was really talking about.
Right. And then last March happens.
They go on this run in the N I T. First time they'd been that deep since, uh, ninety-six.
And they knock off Wake Forest. Seventy-eight, seventy-five.
One point seven seconds left. Johnny Kinziger. And honestly? The shot's not even the interesting part.
The interesting part is what happened after. Because normally, and I mean, this is just the reality of the sport now...
The roster leaves. Everybody transfers up. And Kinziger, and Chase Walker, they, uh... they came back.
For their senior year. In Normal.
So what does that actually give you?
It gives you the one thing almost nobody has anymore. It gives you continuity.
They kept the core. They added pieces. And the whole thing is pointed at one season.
And this time, they're not sneaking up on anybody.
